# Collision and elevation for the maps the NPC tracker simulates, extracted from
# pokefirered data/layouts/<name>/map.bin. Each tile is a u16 whose bits 10-11 are the
# collision value (MAPGRID_COLLISION_MASK) and bits 12-15 the elevation
# (MAPGRID_ELEVATION_SHIFT). One tile per two hex chars: collision then elevation.
# Coordinates are layout-local; the game adds MAP_OFFSET (7) to reach object coords.
